title: David Defeats Ammon and Syria

questions.question: Who became king of the Ammonites after Nahash died?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 10:1 (ESV): "...the king of the Ammonites died, and Hanun his son reigned in his place."

questions.question: Why did David send servants to Hanun?
options: To console him concerning his father
questions.correctAnswer: To console him concerning his father
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 10:2 (ESV): "...So David sent by his servants to console him concerning his father."

questions.question: What did the princes of the Ammonites accuse David's servants of being?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 10:3 (ESV): "...Has not David sent his servants to you to search the city and to spy it out...?"

questions.question: How did Hanun treat David's servants?
options: Shaved half their beards and cut their garments
questions.correctAnswer: Shaved half their beards and cut their garments
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 10:4 (ESV): "So Hanun took David's servants and shaved off half the beard of each and cut off their garments in the middle, at their hips, and sent them away."

questions.question: Who did the Ammonites hire to help them fight David?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 10:6 (ESV): "...the Ammonites sent and hired the Syrians of Beth-rehob..."

questions.question: Where were the men told to stay until their beards grew?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 10:5 (ESV): "...Stay at Jericho until your beards have grown and then return."

questions.question: Who led the Israelites into battle?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 10:9-10 (ESV): "...he selected... and put them in charge of Joab. And the rest of the men he put in charge of Abishai his brother..."

questions.question: What was Joab's strategy?
options: Divide forces to fight two fronts
questions.correctAnswer: Divide forces to fight two fronts
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 10:9-11 (ESV): Joab fought the Syrians, Abishai fought the Ammonites. "If the Syrians are too strong for me, then you shall help me..."

questions.question: What happened when Joab advanced against the Syrians?
Who was the commander of Hadadezer's army?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 10:16 (ESV): "...and Shobach the commander of the army of Hadadezer was at their head."

questions.question: How many talents of silver did the Ammonites pay? (From parallel 1 Chron, but here implies hiring cost context - sticking to 2 Sam text, quantity not specified, but hiring described)
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 10:6 mentions hiring Syrians of Beth-rehob (20,000 foot soldiers) etc., but doesn't specify the cost. Note: 1 Chronicles 19:6 says 1,000 talents. I will avoid this question or replace it.

questions.question: How many Syrian foot soldiers were hired from Beth-rehob and Zobah?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 10:6 (ESV): "...20,000 foot soldiers, and the king of Maacah with 1,000 men, and the men of Tob, 12,000 men."

questions.question: In the second battle, where did David cross the Jordan to meet the Syrians?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 10:16-17 (ESV): "...they came to Helam... David... crossed the Jordan and came to Helam."

questions.question: How many charioteers of the Syrians did David kill in the second battle?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 10:18 (ESV): "And the Syrians fled before Israel, and David killed of the Syrians the men of 700 chariots..."

questions.question: How many horsemen did David kill in the second battle?
Joab encouraged Abishai saying, "May the Lord do ______."
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 10:12 (ESV): "...and may the LORD do what seems good to him."

key_verse_text: Be of good courage, and let us be courageous for our people and for the cities of our God, and may the LORD do what seems good to him. (ESV)
